subject: Problem encountered with the MML estimator

messages.author: ae39ddb5b8c0ddc9
messages.subject: Problem encountered with the MML estimator
parts:
Dear all,
 
I am trying to use the MML estimator in a one-factor CFA. However, I always get the same error message; even when using the Holzinger/Swineford example syntax (see below). I have the latest versions of R and lavaan (0.5-16). Is there a possibility that the MML estimator is not yet fully supported in lavaan? Here is my syntax:
 
Model <- '
#Factor loadings
CU =~ NA*ppbhicut021 + ppbhicut041 + ppbhicut071 + ppbhicut08r1 + ppbhicut09r1 + ppbhicut101 + ppbhicut111 + ppbhicut121 + ppbhicut181 + ppbhicut201 + ppbhicut211 +
ppbhicut03r1 + ppbhicut05r1 + ppbhicut13r1 + ppbhicut15r1 + ppbhicut16r1 + ppbhicut17r1 + ppbhicut23r1 + ppbhicut24r1 +
ppbhicut01r1 + ppbhicut061 + ppbhicut071 + ppbhicut14r1 + ppbhicut19r1 + ppbhicut221
#Factor variance(s)
CU ~~ 1*CU'
Model.fit <- cfa(Model, data = TEDSr,estimator="MML")
 
However, I get the following error:
Error in DD$nu[num.idx, , drop = FALSE] : subscript out of bounds
 
 
I get the very same error when I compute the practice/example syntax from the Holzinger/Swineford data:
data(HolzingerSwineford1939)
HS.model <- 'visual =~ x1 + x2 + x3
textual =~ x4 + x5 + x6
speed =~ x7 + x8 + x9'
Hs.fit <- cfa(HS.model, data = HolzingerSwineford1939,estimator="MML")
 

Thanks in advance,
 
Jeffrey Henry

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Problem encountered with the MML estimator
parts:
On 04/14/2014 03:41 PM, Jeffrey Henry wrote:
> Dear all,
> I am trying to use the MML estimator in a one-factor CFA. However,
> I always get the same error message; even when using the
> Holzinger/Swineford example syntax (see below). I have the latest
> versions of R and lavaan (0.5-16). Is there a possibility that the MML
> estimator is not yet fully supported in lavaan?

The MML estimator currently (0.5-16) only works with categorical data only.

If you have continuous data only, MML == ML, so there is no need for MML.

Yves.
